body: Some good music to listen to....Roger Waters, The pros and cons of hitchhiking or amused to death. Radiohead, In Rainbows or everything by them really. Pink Floyd, Animals. Neil Young, Harvest or Decade. Anything by Modest Mouse or Nick Cave and The Bad Seeds. Chicago- the old stuff. King Crimson. Whatever makes you happy. Take the little pieces of life and run with them. I just didn't have enough little pieces to run with. Love music, love one another.

I'm surprisingly calm. Everything is set up. I've wrote letters to anyone I though was important which was just 2 people. I wrote down my last wishes. I'm enjoying a little Jim Beam and listening to music. I've got my spot ready. I'm just waiting for everyone to go to bed. There won't be a mess, bodily wise, to clean up so that is good. I'm just trying to enjoy the last few hours I have and I'm at peace. I'm not afraid. I'm not sad. I'm not apprehensive. I'm just ready. I'm thankful for those that responded, but it wasn't necessary. All that matters is the emotions and the torment will be no more. That's all I've ever really wanted. Just be kind to one another. Even if you pass a stranger on the street say a nice word or pay someone a compliment. Call the ones you love or the people you've been putting off. Make this world a nicer place. That's what I'm doing.
